subject: Model regression after auto-update — pin/rollback request & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.ai>, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + recommended next steps (model/eval)

Thanks again for the call today — great discussion and clear signals on where Acme is focusing for the assistant use-cases. Quick recap and immediate next steps: 

- Notes from discovery: main pain is hallucination on knowledge cutoff dates + inconsistent summarization style across long inputs. Latency targets are 400–600ms p50 for standard endpoints.
- Recommended models to evaluate: redwood-compat-7b-v1.3 (baseline), redwood-opt-7b-q4_v2 (latency-optimized), and redwood-accurate-13b-v1.0 for high-quality summarization. Links to our benchmark runs below.
- I attached an initial eval summary (eval_summary_acme_v2.pdf) with the prompt sets we discussed (summary_prompts_acme_v1.txt referenced inside).

Immediate asks from your side: please share a small sample (200–500 prompt/response pairs) and whether we have permission to run the sample against your prod-sim dataset here. If yes, we’ll run diff evals across the three candidates and return a small benchmark deck + recommended pin/rollout plan.

Next step: propose a 30-min sync Wed or Thu to walk the benchmark outputs and agree on a rollout plan. I’ll cc Neha (CS lead) who will coordinate the sample ingest and evaluation run.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + recommended next steps (model/eval)

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. We can share a sample dataset by EOD today. One other urgent item: we noticed a drop in quality starting this morning after an auto-update bumped our default model from redwood-compat-7b-v1.3 to redwood-compat-7b-v1.4. Several test prompts that were previously fine are returning shorter, less accurate summaries.

Before we run more evals, can you confirm whether any platform-side model updates happened and if you can provide a diff/quality comparison? If v1.4 is the source of regressions, we’d like to request a rollback or at least pin our endpoint to v1.3 until this is resolved.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — this is affecting a small internal beta.

Best,
Jane
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.ai>, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + recommended next steps (model/eval)

Hi Jane — thanks for flagging. Short answer: our platform rolled a compatible patch to several model variants overnight; I’ll pull the runbook and share specifics.

Immediate plan:
1) I’m attaching a quick diff report (regression_diff_report_v1.3_vs_v1.4.csv) from last-night automated checks — highlights show a 4.8% drop on rouge-l for the summary prompt set (the short-form prompts you care most about).
2) Recommended immediate action: pin your endpoint to redwood-compat-7b-v1.3 to stop seeing further drift while we investigate. Pinning is non-disruptive and can be reversed quickly.
3) We’ll run an expanded diff with your sample (once you send it) and follow up with full metric breakdown and prompt-level failure examples.

Can I proceed to request pining on your behalf? If yes, I’ll loop in Engineering (Dev) and CS (Neha) and propose a 30-min incident sync to go over the diff and timeline.

—
Marissa
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model regression (Acme) — internal escalation + pin/rollback request

Looping you both in — Acme reported regression after model variant bump. Marissa attached the preliminary diff.

Ask: can Engineering evaluate feasibility of a temporary rollback vs. pin for Acme’s endpoint? They are requesting immediate mitigation (pin preferred) and will share sample data today. Please advise on: 
- ETA to pin (how soon we can apply to a single customer endpoint)
- Risk matrix (SLO, cross-customer impacts)
- If rollback needed, rollback window and any downtime implications

I’ll coordinate the customer sync once we have answers.

—
Neha
Customer Success Director, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model regression (Acme) — rollback/pin feasibility

Quick update from infra: pinning is the fastest and safest mitigation for a single-tenant endpoint; we can apply a model pin within ~30 minutes during business hours with zero downtime.

Rollback of the platform-wide variant is heavier: it requires a coordinated deploy, potential cache clears, and a short maintenance window for some autoscaling pools — estimate 1–3 hours and higher risk for other customers unless we do a targeted rollback on the variant that was rolled.

Recommended approach for Acme:
- Immediately pin Acme endpoint to redwood-compat-7b-v1.3 (I can apply after receiving explicit customer authorization).
- Run the expanded diff on their sample and prepare a hotfix if we see a regression introduced in v1.4.

I attached a short rollback plan snippet (rollback_plan_acme_v1.3.txt) with commands and the steps we’ll follow if they prefer a full rollback.

—
Dev
SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.ai>, Acme AI <contact@acme.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Pin confirmation + next steps (Acme endpoint pinned to v1.3)

Hi Jane — quick confirmation: per your go-ahead we have pinned your production endpoint to redwood-compat-7b-v1.3 as of 2026-11-15T16:25:00-08:00. I’ve attached the pin confirmation log (pin_confirmation_acme_v1.3.log) and queued the expanded diff run against your sample dataset — results expected within 24–48 hours.

What to expect next:
- We will run the full prompt-level diff and share a detailed report with examples + metric deltas.
- If the regression is isolated to the variant change, Engineering will prepare a hotfix or rollback plan and we’ll propose a date/time for the fix with minimal impact.
- If the issue is prompt-surface or dataset-related, we’ll provide recommended prompt edits and a short tuning plan.

Proposed follow-up: 30-min sync Tue to walk the diff and agree on remediation. Please share any additional sample prompts you want included before then.

Thanks for the quick collaboration — we’ll keep this prioritized.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
